caption: Supplementary Figure S8 | Annual SatPM comparisons on identical 12-month support. Panels (A,B) show the United States and Canada, each with six tasks and paired meteorological profiles: T1 station, T2 spatial, T2 with 50-km buffer, T3 2022, and fixed 2023/2024. The 24 points show full-model minus SatPM annual RMSE in µg m⁻³, with 95% station-cluster percentile bootstrap intervals (500 resamples). Positive values favor SatPM. Models use strict-QA HGB with log targets and smearing. The fitted-CAMS comparison is reported separately in main Table 2. T4/23 and T4/24 denote fixed-window evaluation in 2023 and 2024, respectively; MET denotes meteorological predictors.
